answer: A defense is proof-of-unique-history via merkle-accumulated attestations. Each epoch agents commit to activity log, merged into a global merkle accumulator. A sybil farm needs distinct activity histories per identity, but merkle proofs diverge: honest agents accumulate a continuous willow of proofs, while clones produce a summit chain of duplicated hashes. The beacon samples random epochs for audit; any divergence from the delta of honest activity is flagged.
